 HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE PANKAJ PUROHIT

M/s Mansa Facility and Services
Private Limited ...... Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ...... Respondents
 Counsel for the petitioner : Ms. Mamta Bisht, learned counsel
 Counsel for the respondents : Mr. J.C. Pande with Mr. Ranjan
Ghildiyal, learned Standing Counsel
for the State
: Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel
for respondent Nos. 2 and 3
The Court made the following:
JUDGMENT: (per Sri Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.)

1) According to the petitioner-company, it was
issued work order for constructing and maintaining 20
smart toilets within the limits of Nagar Nigam, Haridwar.
However, petitioner-company has been allotted only 07
sites and, 07 smart toilets were constructed and handed
over to the Nagar Nigam, Haridwar.
1

UKHC010174092026
2026:UHC:9181-DB
2) By means of this writ petition, the petitioner
has sought a direction to the Nagar Nigam to make
available the remaining sites or to provide some
alternate sites where smart toilets could be
constructed.
3) Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel
appearing for Nagar Nigam, Haridwar submits that the
land over which smart toilets have to be constructed
belongs to various departments of the State
Government; he submits that because of the Kumbh
Mela, which is scheduled to be held in January-February
2027, various aspects have to be considered,
particularly, the safety, security of pilgrims visiting
Kumbh Mela and, the resultant crowd management,
therefore there cannot be any constructions raised on
the sensitive area near banks of river Ganga. He
further submits that if petitioner makes a
representation to the competent authority in Nagar
Nigam, Haridwar, the same shall be dealt with as per
law.
4) The writ petition stands disposed of
accordingly with liberty to the petitioner-company to
make fresh representation to the competent authority
2

UKHC010174092026
2026:UHC:9181-DB
in the Nagar Nigam. If the petitioner-company makes
such representation within 10 days from today, the
competent authority is directed to take decision on the
same, as per law, within two months thereafter.
5) Pending application(s), if any, also stand
disposed of.
 _________________________ MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI, A.C.J.

______________
PANKAJ PUROHIT, J.
